lines.gurmukhi: ਖੂਨ ਕੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੁ ਕਾ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਪਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khoon ke sohile gaaveeahi naanak rat kaa ku(n)goo paai ve laalo ||1||
lines.translation: The wedding songs of murder are sung, O Nanak, and blood is sprinkled instead of saffron, O Lalo. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਸ ਪੁਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਖੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib ke gun naanak gaavai maas puree vich aakh masolaa ||
lines.translation: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord and Master in the city of corpses, and voices this account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਈ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਖਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin upaaee ra(n)g ravaaee baithaa vekhai vakh ikelaa ||
lines.translation: The One who created, and attached the mortals to pleasures, sits alone, and watches this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa so saahib sach tapaavas sachaRaa niaau kareg masolaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master is True, and True is His justice. He issues His Commands according to His judgement.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਿਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਸੀ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kapaR tuk tuk hosee hidusataan samaalasee bolaa ||
lines.translation: The body-fabric will be torn apart into shreds, and then India will remember these words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਨਿ ਅਠਤਰੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਾਨਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਭੀ ਉਠਸੀ ਮਰਦ ਕਾ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan athatarai jaan sataanavai hor bhee uthasee marad kaa chelaa ||
lines.translation: Coming in seventy-eight (1521 A.D.), they will depart in ninety-seven (1540 A.D.), and then another disciple of man will rise up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sach kee baanee naanak aakhai sach sunaaisee sach kee belaa ||2||3||5||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks the Word of Truth; he proclaims the Truth at this, the right time. ||2||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aae hukam khasamaahu hukam sabh varatanee ||
lines.translation: Everyone comes by Command of the Lord and Master. The Hukam of His Command extends to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach saahib saachaa khel sabh har dhanee ||1||
lines.translation: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His play. The Lord is the Master of all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saalaahihu sach sabh oopar har dhanee ||
lines.translation: So praise the True Lord; the Lord is the Master over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਗਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis naahee koi sareek kis lekhai hau ganee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: No one is equal to Him; am I of any account? ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee dharatee aakaas ghar ma(n)dar har banee ||
lines.translation: Air, water, earth and sky - the Lord has made these His home and temple.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vich varatai naanak aap jhooth kahu kiaa ganee ||2||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Nanak. Tell me: what can be counted as false? ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਬਫਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit nihaphal karam kamaai baphaavai duramateeaa ||
lines.translation: The evil-minded person continually does fruitless deeds, all puffed up with pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਣੈ ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਬ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jab aanai valava(n)ch kar jhooth tab jaanai jag jiteeaa ||1||
lines.translation: When he brings home what he has acquired, by practicing deception and falsehood, he thinks that he has conquered the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa baajee saisaar na chetai har naamaa ||
lines.translation: Such is the drama of the world, that he does not contemplate the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਰਾਮਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi binasai sabh jhooth mere man dhiaai raamaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: In an instant, all this false play shall perish; O my mind, meditate on the Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਇ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa velaa chit na aavai jit aai ka(n)tak kaal grasai ||
lines.translation: He does not think of that time, when Death, the Torturer, shall come and seize him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis naanak lae chhadaai jis kirapaa kar hiradai vasai ||2||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord saves that one, within whose heart the Lord, in His Kind Mercy, dwells. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਕ ਨੂਰ ਕਰਦੰ ਆਲਮ ਦੁਨੀਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaak noor karada(n) aalam duneeaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord infused His Light into the dust, and created the world, the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਜਿਮੀ ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: asamaan jimee darakhat aab paidaais khudaai ||1||
lines.translation: The sky, the earth, the trees, and the water - all are the Creation of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਦੇ ਚਸਮ ਦੀਦੰ ਫਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)de chasam deeda(n) phanaai ||
lines.translation: O human being, whatever you can see with your eyes, shall perish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨਂੀਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਖੁਰਦਨੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਹਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: duna(n)eeaa muradaar khuradanee gaaphal havaai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The world eats dead carcasses, living by neglect and greed. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੈਬਾਨ ਹੈਵਾਨ ਹਰਾਮ ਕੁਸਤਨੀ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਬਖੋਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaibaan haivaan haraam kusatanee muradaar bakhoraai ||
lines.translation: Like a goblin, or a beast, they kill and eat the forbidden carcasses of meat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਕਬਜ ਕਬਜਾ ਕਾਦਰੋ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dil kabaj kabajaa kaadaro dojak sajaai ||2||
lines.translation: So control your urges, or else you will be seized by the Lord, and thrown into the tortures of hell. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਲੀ ਨਿਆਮਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਮਿਲਕ ਖਾਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: valee niaamat biraadaraa darabaar milak khaanaai ||
lines.translation: Your benefactors, presents, companions, courts, lands and homes

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਬਸਤਨੀ ਤਬ ਚਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਬਿਦਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jab ajaraaeel basatanee tab ch kaare bidaai ||3||
lines.translation: - when Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death seizes you, what good will these be to you then? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਕਰਦੰ ਪਾਕ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: havaal maaloom karada(n) paak alaah ||
lines.translation: The Pure Lord God knows your condition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਗੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਬੰਦਾਹ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bugo naanak aradaas pes daraves ba(n)daah ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, recite your prayer to the holy people. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: tila(n)g ghar 2 mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Tilang, Second House, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin doojaa naahee koi ||
lines.translation: There is no other than You, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataar karahi so hoi ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator; whatever You do, that alone happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa jor teree man tek ||
lines.translation: You are the strength, and You are the support of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa jap naanak ek ||1||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, meditate, O Nanak, on the One. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh oopar paarabraham daataar ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver is the Supreme Lord God over all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree tek teraa aadhaar || rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are our support, You are our sustainer. ||Pause||
